copy.hook: Goodwill has always reached past what anyone could verify. What if the circle simply kept widening, to minds no one can yet describe?

copy.alt: A small warm gold light in a deep indigo void is ringed by widening rings of rose, amber, teal and lilac. The view opens to a thread of light loosening a dark thorny knot, then to a vast lattice of tiny lights whose glowing motes fall and ripple across a calm surface.
